The '''Spumani''' were breakaway adherents to the [[Children of Mani]] religion.

==Beliefs==
The Spumani believed that [[Mani]], the founder of their religion, had made a secret directive that taught that salvation could only be attained by constantly testing oneself.

==History==
The Spumani split from the orthodox [[Grumani]] in a religious schism, resulting in a conflict that was fought between the two sects for eight hundred years, until the arrival of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. Tenisons between the two groups later cooled to merely mutual disdain.
